About

Turning community needs into practical action

I am an education researcher, community volunteer and social development advocate from Shimshal Valley, Hunza. My M.Phil. in Education and my fieldwork focus on women’s empowerment, inclusive education and educational inequality in Gilgit-Baltistan.

I am experienced in survey design, interviews, field data collection and analysis with SPSS and ATLAS.ti, and I am now preparing for doctoral research on digital and individualised learning support.

Founder · Strong Basic Bright FutureFirst female President · Shimshal Students AssociationGold Medalist · B.Ed (Hons) 2022

Personalised learning plans and digital training for learners with limited access.

Inclusive education

Educational inequality for girls and children from remote and marginalized communities.

Women’s empowerment

Vocational and digital training, and women’s roles in environmental stewardship.
